summary: Describes ACTN, a framework for abstracting and controlling traffic-engineered networks. It builds on the separation of data and control planes and the many management protocols, so that customers and controllers can see and drive virtual, abstracted views of underlying networks.

eli5.summary: A big road system is complicated, so you give each user a simple map and a remote control for just the part they need.
